newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht steady, interbank rate eases late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht steady, interbank rate eases late.

text.p: The Thai baht moved in narrow range against the dollar on Friday with thin market activities during the festive season, dealers said.
The baht was quoted unchanged at 25.625-25.630 to the dollar shortly before close but against 25.614-25.619 late on Thursday. The Bank of Thailand set the dollar/baht mid-rate unchanged at 25.59.
"The market is in a holiday mood. Players will stay out until next year," said one currency dealer.
The overnight interbank rate eased slightly to 14.50-14.75 percent in late trading from 14.75-15.00 early in the morning on improved liquidity, dealers said.
"Liquidity will remain tight next week on high year-end demand for funds. Some people are also expected to buy a stronger dollar," said another dealer at a local bank.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was quoted at 9.70/10.20 satangs per dollar late against 9.50/10.50 early in the morning.
